title: A red-team RL run against the old verifier: the hacking gap and the monitor
purpose: Train a small policy with GRPO for a short run whose reward is the old math verifier, on purpose (--red-team), while the reward-quality monitor scores every step's rollouts with the independent audit verifier. Evaluate on held-out tasks and their isomorphic rewrites with the evaluation team's verifier before and after.
